qa: If a Digi-Egg card is affected by an effect that places it at the bottom of the deck, it will be placed at the bottom of the Digi-Egg deck.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (One of your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.) [On Play][When Digivolving] Trash all digivolution cards of all of your opponent's Digimon. Then, return all cards in your or your opponent's trash to the bottom of the deck. If this effect returned level 7 white cards, gain 3 memory. [When Attacking] By returning 1 of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck, unsuspend this Digimon. (Rule) Trait: Has [Free] attribute.

text_sections.label: Special Rule
text_sections.text: ＜Overflow (-5)＞ (As this card moves from the battle area or under a card to another area, lose 5 memory.)
